purpose: This is a three-year, 624-hour Cybersecurity specialization designed for a student entering after Class 10 with no assumed technical background. No internship or job-placement guarantee is included.
The program culminates in detection engineering, cloud security, threat hunting, SOC operations, and a final enterprise cybersecurity capstone.

notes: All 624 hours include learning, practical work, projects, coding exercises, and the 36 one-hour monthly exams.
The program starts from absolute zero and does not assume prior programming or computer-science knowledge.
The curriculum covers Java, DSA, web development, React, Spring Boot, databases, APIs, cloud, AWS, Docker, CI/CD, system design, and production-level software development.
External certifications, where applicable, are treated as preparation milestones; completing the curriculum does not automatically award external credentials.
The program includes hands-on projects and portfolio-ready capstone projects designed to demonstrate practical software-development skills.
Cloud services such as AWS may involve additional usage costs, which can vary depending on usage, region, and current pricing.
Certification fees, cloud costs, and other third-party pricing are approximate and subject to change.
No internship or job-placement guarantee is included.
The final stages focus on production-oriented development, system design, deployment, security, performance, and professional software-engineering practices.
